title.english: Layla bint 'Abd Allah al-'Adawiyya (6): She is al-Shifa'. Her biography appeared previously. Al-Mustaghfiri, citing Ibn Hibban, gave this as her name.

(٣) أسد الغابة ت (٧٢٦٧) .
(٤) أسد الغابة ت (٧٢٦٨) .
(٥) أسد الغابة ت (٧٢٧٠) .
(٦) أسد الغابة ت (٧٢٧١)، الثقات ٣/ ٣٦١- أعلام النساء ٢/ ٣٠٠- الكاشف ٣/ ٤٧٤- تجريد أسماء الصحابة ٢/ ٢٨١، ٣٠٣- تهذيب الكمال ٣/ ١٦٨٦- تقريب التهذيب ٢/ ٦٠٢- تهذيب التهذيب ١٢/ ٤٢٨.

(1) Usd al-Ghaba, entry (7264).

(2) Usd al-Ghaba, entry (7265).

(3) Usd al-Ghaba, entry (7267).

(4) Usd al-Ghaba, entry (7268).

(5) Usd al-Ghaba, entry (7270).

(6) Usd al-Ghaba, entry (7271); al-Thiqat, 3/361; A'lam al-Nisa', 2/300; al-Kashif, 3/474; al-Tajrid, 2/281, 303; Tahdhib al-Kamal, 3/1686; Taqrib al-Tahdhib, 2/602; Tahdhib al-Tahdhib, 12/428.

unresolved.explanation: The consonantal spelling is secure, but neither the canonical Arabic nor the matching Urdu witness is vocalized, and the collateral Arabic evidence supplies no exact vocalized occurrence. “Tanat ibn Mu'ayyis” is therefore retained provisionally.
